description: HQ100 - Verschneidungsergebnis Wasserspiegellage mit DHM bei einem HQ100 Ereignis is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Intersection result Water level position with DHM at an HQ100 event - the dataset represents all areas that are lower than the water level (without technical flood protection) Class up to 0 is above the WSP - no representation, in blue tones the water depths are graded according to the following classes: 0-0.5m 0.5-1m 1-2m ... Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "HQ100 - Intersection result Water level position with DHM at an HQ100 event" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include SUIS, Geowissenschaften, Saarland, ARCHIV, HOCHWASSER_RASTER_min100_clip. The listing shows 2012-05-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
